data.one_liner: Flutter FFI plugin that bundles PDFium for native PDF rendering on Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
data.what_it_does: It packages PDFium native binaries and exposes low‑level FFI bindings so Flutter apps can load and render PDFs directly. The plugin also handles platform‑specific asset packaging and XCFramework integration.
use_when: You need direct, low‑level access to PDFium for custom PDF processing or rendering
You target native Flutter platforms (mobile, desktop) and require a bundled PDF engine
You want automatic native binary handling without managing PDFium yourself
avoid_when: You need a high‑level PDF viewer widget or web support
You prefer a pure‑Dart solution without native toolchains
You are building for the web
strengths: Cross‑platform native PDFium binaries are bundled automatically
Supports multi‑engine applications via a process‑wide gate
Handles iOS/macOS XCFramework integration via CocoaPods/SwiftPM
No separate download step for PDFium binaries
weaknesses: Low‑level API requires manual handling of PDF rendering
Requires a C toolchain for native builds
data.setup_notes: A C toolchain is required to compile the bundled gate library on native platforms. iOS/macOS need CocoaPods or Swift Package Manager for the XCFramework. Ensure Flutter 3.47+ and Dart 3.13+.
